goal.decided: An AI that the user instructs finishes the work the user gave overnight while nobody answers, and reports the results in the morning: a task stopped by the usage limit goes on once the limit resets, and the tasks run three at once unless the AI sets another number.

decisions.decided: An AI uses it: the user gives the instruction, and the AI arranges the work.

The AI finishes the work the user instructed overnight while nobody answers, and reports the results in the morning. A task stopped by the usage limit goes on once the limit resets. Tasks run three at once by default, and the number can be set.
